next_evidence: Identify exact B284L engine number/build to distinguish old vs new cam-drive WIS procedure and genuine US FWD vehicle
Before cranking, have competent assessor clear mechanical seizure, oil-starvation, timing loss or coolant ingress risks
If safe, perform year-matched controlled compression, actual oil-pressure diagnosis and applicable cam drive checks; do not infer chain failure from sound alone

repair_options.work: Confirmed isolated oil-pressure sensor/feed or accessible peripheral fault may be repairable; WIS documents compression and oil-pressure procedures with specific equipment
requires: original-year WIS, safe engine clearance, gauge and lift/heat protection

repair_options.work: B284 cam drive differs between versions; complex chain/tensioner work needs special tools and precise timing. Proven piston/valve contact or lower bearing damage is beyond a simple DIY project
requires: year/version WIS, EN-48383/EN-46111 equipment, assessment of engine health, actual quote

evidence_limits: MY2007 Saab WIS includes old/new B284 versions; not every 2006–08 US car uses the same kit or procedure
No failure-frequency evidence, actual VIN, oil-pressure/compression measurement or labor-price evidence
Do not infer universal B284 chain defect or use B207 parts/procedures
unknowns: Exact V6 build-break/engine-code variant, original-year compression and oil-pressure criteria
Current replacement timing parts/tool availability and shop quote

scenarios.name: 2011 NG 9-5 Turbo4 A20NFT/LHU candidate mechanical oil pressure and timing triage

applicability.factory_engine_VIN_required: Source production row 2.0T only; verify actual Saab MY2011 engine VIN code and installed LHU/LDK variant before applying instructions

symptoms: oil pressure lamp or deep knock
no crank, misfire and valve train rattle
next_evidence: Confirm original 2011 US Turbo4 VIN and physical engine ID; production source abbreviation does not prove variant or aftermarket cross fit
If safely runnable, Saab MY2011 diagnostic path distinguishes oil sender/filter, drainback O-ring, pump/strainer or bypass from excessive bearing clearance
If suspected cam timing loss, use original MY2011 EN-49212 camshaft locking tool check and controlled leakdown/compression only after safe mechanical clearance

repair_options.work: A confirmed sender/filter/bypass or independently isolated accessible peripheral issue can be considered separately from internal engine wear
requires: factory MY2011 diagnostic equipment, actual engine code, pressure measurement

repair_options.work: Severe bearing damage, seized engine, valve/piston contact or uncontrolled compression loss outside DIY no-rebuild target; get complete compatible unit quote or reject
requires: original VIN engine variant, safe confirmation and written price

evidence_limits: WIS LDK/LHU manufacturer generic pages not automatically authorization for every VIN/RPO US Turbo4
Does not establish timing-chain failure frequency or worn bearing incidence
No personal car VIN, physical stamping or live compression/oil pressure
unknowns: 2011 US option/RPO VIN and special-tool availability
price and provenance of complete engine vs internal repair

scenarios.name: 2006–2011 U.S. FWD 9-3 B207 FA57 five-speed control versus internal failure

next_evidence: Identify actual FA57 case and TCM hardware/calibration and confirm year and FWD; obtain DTCs/freeze frames before resets or replacing a controller
For safe running vehicle and qualified professional, distinguish selector/range switch, input/output speed sensor, fluid/cooler and TCM adaptation from confirmed clutch/valve-body/mechanical failure
After verified correct-level/test and repairable cause investigation, request a complete transmission swap quote if internal slip/gear ratio mismatch persists

repair_options.work: Saab WIS identifies selector cable/range switch, speed sensors, cooler lines, TCM adaptation as separately diagnosable; unit-specific tools/Tech2 programming required
requires: Tech2/TIS2000 access for TCM operations, specific MY/gearbox WIS, safe test

repair_options.work: Full FA57 assembly replacement requires engine support and extensive driveline/subframe lowering, transmission lifting tools and adaptation
requires: qualified lift, original VIN family/case label, donor fitment and quote

evidence_limits: 2009 WIS diagnosis and 2010 TCM procedure used as bounded research across 2006–11; *not* an assertion all years have identical electronics/software or failure patterns
FA57 application label does not authorize 9-3/9-5 donor interchange
Never do unsafe stall or test drive on nonrunning/uninspected Saab
unknowns: Original year- and VIN-specific calibration and repair authorization
Current Tech2, fluid/parts costs, actual gearbox shift/mechanical state

scenarios.name: 2011 NG 9-5 Turbo4 AF40 FWD six-speed solenoid versus hydraulic failure

applicability.factory_vin_gate: Verify MY2011 9-5 VIN gearbox code A for FWD 6AT and case/RPO before using generic M36/MXE procedures

symptoms: CHECK GEARBOX with pressure control codes P0748/P0961–63
next_evidence: Confirm actual FWD automatic VIN coding and installed AF40 case; read full TCM DTCs and preserve freeze frames, do not clear
Saab MY2011 diagnostic chart distinguishes wiring shorts/open SLT solenoid, control-module signals and valve body from real clutch/pump/hydraulic damage
Pressure/ratio tests require original MY2011 matching RPO/scan tool, appropriate operating conditions and safe vehicle; do not assume electrical code proves or rules out gearbox failure

repair_options.work: When cause is demonstrated as external wiring or control-solenoid/valve-body subassembly, Saab WIS lists circuit and subassembly tests ahead of complete gearbox replacement
requires: matching 2011 RPO/module/scan tool, electronics competence, correct AF40 fluid method and controlled test

repair_options.work: Proven repeated hydraulic pressure loss, internal mechanical slipping or damage beyond subassembly service requires a full gearbox-swap quotation or exclusion under no-rebuild goal
requires: exact AF40 variant/torque converter/TCM programming and lift estimate

evidence_limits: 2011 9-5 WIS P0748/P0733 procedures encompass gearbox/engine RPO choices; manufacturer exact Turbo4 FWD applicability and calibration needs actual case/VIN
Do not transfer 9-3 AF40 fluid specification/TCM into 2011 9-5
Electrical codes and gear-ratio issues alone do not establish a replacement unit or fault prevalence
unknowns: MY2011 FWD Turbo4 exact case/model options and module part IDs
repair and complete-transmission replacement costs

scenarios.name: Original 9-3 9400 semi-rigid rear axle versus structural sill/floor/frame repair

symptoms: severely corroded sill/rocker or lift points
uncertain floor or body pickup integrity
next_evidence: Assess rear axle spring links, mounting bushes and body anchor points without assuming 9440 rear-subframe layout
Inspect 3D/5D rocker inner/outer sills, wheelhouses, rear floor and longitudinal frame member by qualified safe lift and body specialist if suspect
Separate isolated replaceable rear beam/bush from corroded bolt anchor, rear shell, crumple structure or lift point; avoid crawling beneath an unverified vehicle

repair_options.work: Manufacturer has rear axle bush/beam service procedure with proper axle/spring/brake-line support, special press tool and bleeding
requires: sound mounting metal, safe lift, bush tool, brake hydraulics competence and year-specific parts

repair_options.work: Rear frame member/rocker/rear floor replacement is welded alignment-bench collision/bodywork including seal and corrosion protection
requires: Saab MY/body-specific cutting limits and approved body repair quote

evidence_limits: 2003 9400 source manual applies only as platform service lead; does not imply US eligible 2003 hatchback
MY2000/02 procedures cannot be blindly projected to all VIN/body variations
No verified real car rust thickness, rear anchor integrity, repair cost or original part availability
unknowns: Real MY1999–2002 3D/5D original Saab shell repair boundaries
US rust/structural inspection with photographs and written alignment/body quote

scenarios.name: 2011 9-5 650 FWD rear suspension support and load-bearing rocker/body integrity

applicability.vin_suspension_RPO_gate: Confirm original US 2011 Turbo4 automatic/FWD VIN and rear suspension GNC vs GNE FWD option (do not apply AWD service option)

symptoms: severely corroded sill/rocker or lift points
uncertain floor or body pickup integrity
next_evidence: Confirm original MY2011 FWD and actual rear suspension RPO GNC versus GNE; assess loaded suspension bolt anchors and body floor and rocker metal, not only removable rear support
Verify safe factory lifting surfaces before touching underbody or moving corroded vehicle; obtain qualified inspection of rear rails and rocker reinforcement
Distinguish bolt-on rear subframe replacement with new fasteners and alignment from welded structural panel/rail sectioning and loss of strength

repair_options.work: WIS describes FWD rear-support replacement with lift, strapped transmission jack, numerous link/parking brake disconnections, new bolts and alignment
requires: original MY2011 GNC/GNE RPO, approved lift and support, torque-angle tools and alignment

repair_options.work: MY2011 outer rocker/frame reinforcements use limited authorized sectioning methods; compromised mounting metal is not restored by simply replacing a rear support
requires: collision-repair qualification, exact cut areas, written structural safety assessment and budget

evidence_limits: GNE FWD and GNC have different source procedures and actual factory RPO applicability is unknown for the source Turbo4 generic row
The existence of an approved panel sectioning procedure does not certify a rusted vehicle safe or prove DIY welding is economical
No observed VIN/case/RPO, physical metal thickness or priced part/repair
unknowns: Factory build-specific rear suspension RPO, exact MY2011 US FWD beam service parts
Actual structural condition and lift-point certification
Specialist welding/alignment estimate

coverage_policy: Applicability is a research applicability cue only, not a claim the car suffered a fault. Generic structure/safety checks apply to candidate groups as preventive inspection. A single-source model-year service procedure is not projected as an approved all-year repair procedure.
cost_policy: All numeric costs and labor hours are null; current itemized local estimates needed before buy/repair recommendations.
approval_policy: All part-interchange, failure-frequency and individual-vehicle approval flags remain false.
gate_status: Phase 0 Gate A partial, B/C unmet.
